games.name: 💎 Ore Smelting Tycoon
games.desc:
💎 Welcome to Ore Smelting Tycoon! 💎

🔗 Join the roblox group Spugh Studios in the description below to get a +25% cash boost when selling ores, and codes!

📚 This is a tycoon game about collecting ores dispensed from your huge ore tycoon, you smelt your ores in the ore smelter to gain cash and upgrade your tycoon to become an ore empire!

🎮 Gameplay:
- You collect ores from your ore dispenser!
- Smelt ores from your inventory for cash!
- Upgrade your tycoon for better ores!
- Rebirth to gain a big cash multiplier!
- Compete in various leaderboards!

📙 Update Log:
- Added the 2nd and 3rd floor with new Ore Rocks!
- New Rebirth Upgrades have been added!
- You can now see your Tokens below Cash!
- Added purchasing Tokens with Robux!
- Fixed ores getting stuck in the tycoon.

🏅 Credits:
@SamirDevs - Developer
@9_Spy - VFX Artist
@Quark_WF - Inspiration

games.name: Bits Incremental!
games.desc:
Welcome to Bits Incremental! [V2.1.0]

This game is basically an incremental where you click to spawn various "bits"!
With these bits you can purchase upgrades and discover new currencies!
You can also compete for leaderboards!
However, you'll need some luck to advance in game!

Join the group to start with extra bits!

To play in CO-OP multiplayer, you will need to use the new multiplayer menu in the main menu. Please note the 200p servers do not save data, as they are intended as one giant coop session.

Local splitscreen requires the use of controllers. Some devices may not support 8 players.

The game DOES save your data!
Note that there may be some bugs, please tell me if so!

Inspired by "Clicker Incremental" by @DaMouseDev

Made by @TheAntOfTheWorld for Ant Nest Studio
Helped by scripter @louisd5
